name: Quake
description: The epicentre and its isoseismals, drawn as square shells so the whole cell reads as a map.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 8%; height: 8%; margin: 46%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: @m6(0 0 0 calc(@n * 3.4px * 6 / @size-col) @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
